definition: Structure mining or structured data mining is the process of finding and extracting useful information from semi-structured data sets.
details: Graph mining, sequential pattern mining and molecule mining are special cases of structured data mining.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Think of it this way: Structure mining or structured data mining is the process of finding and extracting useful information from semi-structured data sets. And here is the clever part: Graph mining, sequential pattern mining and molecule mining are special cases of structured data mining. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. And that is Structure mining — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
